dct_description_sm: Aeronautical chart showing designated helicopter routes and control areas.

Aeronautical chart showing designated helicopter routes and control areas. Relief shown by spot heights. "Includes airspace amendments effective November 4, 1999." Panel title. Includes text, notes, directories, "Downtown Manhattan inset", and statistical table. Text and index of routes on verso. Maps on verso: Statue of Liberty/Ellis Island inset -- Westchester inset. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
